title: Obsidian Mind vault gives Claude Code and Codex persistent project memory
summary: Promotion of Obsidian Mind, an open-source Obsidian vault template that gives Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI persistent markdown memory for projects, decisions, tasks, and notes across sessions.
question_it_answers: How can coding agents keep durable project memory in an Obsidian vault instead of restarting cold?

claims.text: Obsidian Mind is an open-source Obsidian vault that stores projects, decisions, tasks, and notes so coding agents retain context across sessions.
claims.evidence: Obsidian Mind is an open-source Obsidian vault that gives AI coding agents persistent memory across sessions.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge
